plan.subject: Marketing science

queries.query: ("charm pricing" OR "left-digit effect" OR ".99 pricing" OR "price ending") AND (marketing OR consumer OR retail OR ecommerce OR pricing)
queries.rationale: Isolates empirical tests on price-ending psychology to validate whether .99 strategies still drive conversion in modern e-commerce.

queries.query: ("discount backlash" OR "promotion fatigue" OR "brand dilution" OR "deal dependency") AND (marketing OR consumer OR retail OR ecommerce OR branding)
queries.rationale: Targets research measuring long-term brand equity erosion and customer deal-proneness from frequent promotional campaigns.

queries.query: ("ad creative" OR "creative execution" OR "visual complexity" OR "message framing") AND (marketing OR consumer OR ecommerce OR advertising OR conversion)
queries.rationale: Captures experimental studies on which visual and copy elements in paid ads actually move click-through and purchase rates.

queries.query: ("product naming" OR "brand name" OR "phonetic symbolism" OR "name fluency") AND (marketing OR consumer OR branding OR retail OR ecommerce)
queries.rationale: Finds evidence on how name pronounceability, length, and sound symbolism influence perceived quality and initial conversion.

queries.query: ("scarcity cue" OR "limited availability" OR "urgency message" OR "countdown timer") AND (ecommerce OR checkout OR conversion OR retail OR "online shopping")
queries.rationale: Focuses specifically on time/quantity constraints placed near the buy button to measure their direct impact on cart completion.

queries.query: ("choice architecture" OR "default option" OR "nudge intervention" OR "friction reduction") AND (marketing OR consumer OR ecommerce OR "checkout flow" OR conversion)
queries.rationale: Covers behavioral interventions that simplify decision paths or alter defaults to reduce checkout abandonment without discounts.

queries.query: ("landing page optimization" OR "conversion copywriting" OR "page layout" OR "call to action") AND (ecommerce OR marketing OR retail OR "digital marketing" OR conversion)
queries.rationale: Targets A/B and multivariate tests isolating page-level variables like headline placement, copy tone, and button design.

queries.query: ("social proof" OR "online review" OR "rating display" OR "testimonial effect") AND (ecommerce OR checkout OR conversion OR retail OR "online shopping")
queries.rationale: Examines how review volume, valence, and placement timing influence purchase confidence and average order value.

queries.query: ("free shipping" OR "shipping threshold" OR "minimum order value" OR "shipping cost framing") AND (ecommerce OR retail OR checkout OR cart OR "online shopping")
queries.rationale: Captures research on how delivery cost structures and minimum spend thresholds shift basket size and conversion probability.

queries.query: ("personalized offer" OR "behavioral targeting" OR "recommendation engine" OR "algorithmic curation") AND (ecommerce OR marketing OR retail OR conversion OR "online shopping")
queries.rationale: Finds field experiments measuring the incremental lift of tailored product suggestions versus generic merchandising.

queries.query: ("cart abandonment" OR "checkout dropout" OR "abandonment recovery" OR "retargeting email") AND (ecommerce OR retail OR "online shopping" OR conversion OR marketing)
queries.rationale: Isolates studies on post-exit recovery tactics, timing, and messaging that successfully recapture lost DTC revenue.

queries.query: ("trust seal" OR "security badge" OR "payment assurance" OR "perceived risk") AND (ecommerce OR checkout OR conversion OR "online shopping" OR retail)
queries.rationale: Targets empirical tests on how security badges and guarantee language lower perceived transaction risk at the point of payment.

queries.query: ("decoy effect" OR "anchoring effect" OR "price anchoring" OR "asymmetric dominance") AND (marketing OR consumer OR retail OR ecommerce OR pricing)
queries.rationale: Covers choice-set manipulation research to identify how reference prices and tier structuring steer customers toward target SKUs.

queries.query: ("free trial" OR "subscription conversion" OR "trial period" OR "freemium model") AND (marketing OR consumer OR ecommerce OR retail OR conversion)
queries.rationale: Focuses on DTC subscription models to find optimal trial lengths, paywall timing, and conversion friction points.

plan.coverage_notes: This plan uses Pattern A across 14 distinct DTC growth levers, pairing tightly scoped pricing/creative/UX phenomena with broad e-commerce/marketing category anchors. It deliberately skips theoretical consumer psychology, historical advertising analysis, and pure media theory to match the profile's demand for actionable, numbers-backed findings. Queries cover the full funnel: acquisition (creative, naming), consideration (pricing anchors, social proof), conversion (nudges, shipping, trust), and retention (subscription trials, cart recovery).
